A '''drag course''' used for [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] existed on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. The [[Fluggrian/Legends|Fluggrian]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Kam Nale|Elan Mak]] was favored here, and would challenge other racers to one-on-one matches.<ref name="EiR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The course first appeared, unnamed, in the [[1999]] [[Wikipedia:Nintendo Game Boy|Gameboy Color]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]''.<ref name="EiR" />
